name: Jonah
lede: The thirty-second book of the Bible, in full: Jonah fleeing unto Tarshish from the presence of Jehovah, the mighty tempest and the lot, three days and three nights in the belly of the great fish — salvation is of Jehovah — then Nineveh, that great city, in sackcloth and ashes, and the gourd that came up in a night and perished in a night — every word in the words of the ASV.

books.name: The Great Fish
books.blurb: Arise, go to Nineveh, that great city — but Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish, and went down to Joppa; a great wind upon the sea, the mariners crying every man unto his god, and Jonah fast asleep; the lot fell upon Jonah — I am a Hebrew, and I fear Jehovah; take me up, and cast me forth into the sea; a great fish to swallow up Jonah, and his prayer out of the fish's belly: salvation is of Jehovah.

books.name: That Great City
books.blurb: The word of Jehovah the second time; yet forty days, and Nineveh shall be overthrown; the people of Nineveh believed God, and the king laid his robe from him and sat in ashes — who knoweth whether God will not turn and repent?; but it displeased Jonah exceedingly: doest thou well to be angry?; the booth on the east side of the city, the gourd, the worm and the sultry east wind; and should not I have regard for Nineveh, that great city?
